response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT a.translink AS translink, t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr >= 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL), combo AS (SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matched GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, cnt AS match_count, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM combo ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each advancedbehavior row with peercorr >= 0.149 counts as one matched record per joined transaction record; the count is the number of such joined rows per (translink, ordertypedist).
Ties in the fraction are broken arbitrarily since no tiebreaker was specified.
